title: Prompt agents can hand function calls back to clients
summary:
Prompt agents gained client tools, community agents got smarter about model selection, and Polli added routes into Codex and Claude Code.

Prompt agents now accept caller-defined function tools alongside configured MCP tools. The agent executes MCP tools on the server and returns caller function calls for the client to run and replay, in streaming or non-streaming Responses and Chat Completions requests. The API docs now explain how to continue those conversations.

Quest contributions added Frugal, a cost-first code-agent example, and Prism, an engineering-review agent. Both classify requests locally and select compatible models using price and health information. Frugal preserves tool history and adds a best-effort trace to non-streaming responses; Prism adds a review rubric for more involved requests.

New `polli harness codex` and `polli harness claude-code` commands set up, check, and remove Pollinations routing through the respective router tools, with model selection and a routed smoke test. The hosted MCP transcription tool can now fetch direct public HTTPS audio URLs, and a CLI update fixes error exits that could trigger an abort on Windows with Node 23+.

daily.title: Client tools for prompt agents
daily.text: Pass your own function tools to prompt agents alongside their MCP tools. The agent returns calls for your client to execute and replay, with streaming and non-streaming support. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Polli routes coding clients
daily.text: Use `polli harness codex` or `polli harness claude-code` to connect those clients through their router tools, select a compatible model, and check routing status. [Find Polli on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Frugal routes code requests
daily.text: Try `community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal`, a community code-agent example that picks compatible models using estimated request cost and recent health. It preserves conversation and tool history when forwarding requests. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal).

daily.title: Prism reviews engineering work
daily.text: Try `cesus-agent/prism-code-review-router` for code-review requests. It chooses a compatible model based on the task, model health, pricing, and available balance, then adds a review rubric for more involved work. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
